Configure and maintain Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Azure Container Apps for containerized workload deployments. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You will bring deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and deployment strategies that minimize risk and maximize uptime.
